world.title: Tata Sons board meeting put off after Noel Tata's objection
world.summary: Tata Sons has postponed a significant board meeting originally scheduled to address the future of the holding company's listing. The delay follows an objection raised by Noel Tata, chairman of Tata Trusts. The meeting's agenda included key discussions on strategic decisions affecting the company's direction. Further details regarding the rescheduling and implications of this postponement remain unclear.

world.title: Ukraine claims drone strikes on Russian ships off Libya: What do we know?
world.summary: Ukraine has claimed responsibility for drone strikes that sank a Russian warship and damaged a cargo vessel off the coast of Libya. This incident raises concerns about the potential geographical expansion of the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The strikes were conducted by Ukrainian forces, highlighting the ongoing tensions and the possibility of the war affecting regions beyond Eastern Europe.

world.title: Indonesia seizes Bangladesh-bound cargo ship carrying chemicals from China that could make 100 missiles
world.summary: The Indonesian Navy has seized a Comoros-flagged cargo ship transporting 405 tonnes of sodium perchlorate, a chemical capable of being used in missile production. The vessel was bound for Bangladesh and originated from China. Sodium perchlorate is a potent oxidizer commonly utilized in industrial applications, raising concerns about its potential military use in missile development.

business.title: RBI retains SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as systemically important banks in 2026 list
business.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has retained State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank as systemically important banks in its 2026 list. The additional capital requirements for these banks remain unchanged, with SBI facing the highest Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) surcharge of 0.80 percent. This designation underscores their significance in the financial system.

business.title: Tata Sons board meeting put off after Noel Tata's objection
business.summary: Tata Sons postponed a crucial board meeting originally scheduled to discuss the listing of the holding company. The delay was prompted by an objection from Noel Tata. The meeting will now take place four days later. This decision reflects ongoing internal discussions regarding the future direction of the conglomerate, which is India's largest.

business.title: Coal India unit Mahanadi's IPO fully subscribed on final day, led by institutional investors
business.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields' initial public offering (IPO) was fully subscribed on its final bidding day, primarily driven by institutional investors. The IPO, consisting entirely of an offer-for-sale, involved existing investors reducing their stakes. Coal India aimed to sell approximately 662 million shares, representing a 10% stake, with anchor investors purchasing a portion and around 493 million shares available for others.

technology.title: Vivo S70, S70 flagship edition to launch in December: Check expected features and camera details
technology.summary: Vivo has announced the launch of the S70 series, which includes the Vivo S70 and S70 flagship edition, set for December 2026 in China. Pre-orders are currently open. The new smartphones are expected to feature advanced specifications and camera capabilities, although detailed features have yet to be disclosed. Further information will likely emerge closer to the launch date.

technology.title: iPhone 17 price drop alert, check deal here
technology.summary: The iPhone 17 is currently discounted on Flipkart, priced at Rs 89,100, down from Rs 99,900. Customers can save an additional Rs 4,000 through bank offers, totaling nearly Rs 15,000 in savings. This promotion highlights the ongoing sales strategy for the iPhone 17, making it more accessible to consumers looking for deals on the latest model.

technology.title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India launch on November 24: Check expected price, 7,000mAh battery, camera and other features
technology.summary: Motorola will launch the Edge 70 Neo in India on November 24. The smartphone features a 7,000mAh battery, a 144Hz AMOLED display, and is powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 processor. Details regarding its camera, charging capabilities, expected price, and availability have been shared, providing potential buyers with comprehensive information ahead of the launch.

sports.title: Ashwin foresees Rishabh Pant's Sandpaper saga chirps against Australia
sports.summary: R Ashwin predicts Rishabh Pant may reference the Sandpaper saga during the upcoming India-Australia Test series, highlighting the potential for sledging related to past controversies. He also noted cultural differences in addressing such scandals and commended Cricket Australia's firm response in 2018. Former cricketers Matthew Hayden and Irfan Pathan shared their views on how Australia should navigate these discussions.

sports.title: Skipper Shubman Gill slams Basin Reserve pitch, ball quality
sports.summary: India's Shubman Gill criticized the Basin Reserve pitch and the quality of the balls used in the first Test against New Zealand, which ended in a draw. He noted that the balls became soft too quickly and questioned their manufacturing standards. Gill also suggested that the ban on using saliva to polish the ball should be reconsidered.

sports.title: MS Dhoni To Mentor CSK, Not Participate In IPL 2027 Auction
sports.summary: Irfan Pathan confirmed that MS Dhoni will serve as a mentor for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL 2027, emphasizing his focus on player development instead of participating in the auction. Pathan noted Dhoni's preference for behind-the-scenes roles and trust in CSK's management. Former batter Abhinav Mukund suggested that CSK needs to strengthen its bowling department for future success.

health.title: Lung Cancer Awareness Month: When A Cough Refuses To Go Away, It Could Be An Early Sign, Says Thoracic Surgeon
health.summary: Thoracic surgeon Dr. Prriya Eshpuniyani highlights that a persistent cough or worsening breathlessness can be early signs of lung cancer. These symptoms are frequently dismissed as effects of pollution, allergies, smoking, or recurrent respiratory infections. Lung Cancer Awareness Month serves as a reminder for individuals, especially smokers, to be vigilant about such symptoms and seek medical evaluation.

health.title: What babies eat could shape their adult sweet tooth. Here’s what scientists found
health.summary: Research on mice indicates that early exposure to different flavors may significantly influence food preferences in adulthood. Scientists discovered that inhibitory neurons, which manage communication between nerve cells, are particularly responsive to experiences during the initial weeks after birth. This suggests that what babies eat could shape their future sweet tooth and overall taste preferences.

health.title: Soha Ali Khan Wears A CGM To Track Blood Sugar: What The Device Does And Who Needs It
health.summary: Soha Ali Khan has begun using a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) to track her blood sugar levels. The device provides real-time data on glucose fluctuations, which can benefit not only diabetics but also non-diabetics interested in health monitoring. The increasing popularity of wearable health technology has prompted discussions about its applications beyond traditional medical use.

science.title: Giant planet discovered near a small star - SCMP
science.summary: Chinese and American astronomers discovered the exoplanet HIP 88962 b, which has a mass nearly five times that of Jupiter. This giant planet orbits a dim star that is about two-thirds the mass of the Sun. The discovery was made during observations conducted in Chile, marking a significant addition to the study of exoplanets and their characteristics.

science.title: Young researchers reveal relativity alters traditional triple bond chemistry
science.summary: Brown University researchers have found that Einstein's theory of relativity influences chemical bonding in heavy elements, specifically bismuth. This discovery challenges traditional understandings of triple bond chemistry, suggesting that the structure of certain chemical bonds is altered by relativistic effects. The findings provide direct experimental evidence, prompting a re-evaluation of foundational principles in chemical bonding education.

science.title: Artificial intelligence for the characterization of particles and fibers by optical microscopy
science.summary: A new artificial intelligence framework automates the characterization of particles and fibers using optical microscopy. It employs a multimodal teacher to combine visual and text embeddings related to specimen properties. A student vision transformer is trained to reconstruct these embeddings from images alone. The system achieves about 80% validation accuracy and 75% Recall@1 for retrieval and classification tasks.

entertainment.title: Panchayat 5 trailer: Phulera braces for new politics, twist in Sachivji's love story
entertainment.summary: The official trailer for Panchayat Season 5 was released on Monday, highlighting political changes and turmoil in Phulera. The new season features an unexpected twist in Sachivji and Rinki's relationship. The comedy-drama series stars Jitendra Kumar, Raghubir Yadav, and Neena Gupta, continuing to explore the complexities of rural governance and personal relationships in a humorous context.

entertainment.title: Behind Notice To Amitabh Bachchan Over KBC, A 'Punjab Question' That Was An AI Clip
entertainment.summary: Amitabh Bachchan received a notice regarding a controversial question from 'Kaun Banega Crorepati' that implied the AAP government's failure in maintaining law and order in Punjab. The question, which suggested criminals were "not afraid" to commit bomb blasts, sparked outrage and claims of defamation against Punjab. The incident highlights tensions surrounding governance and public safety in the state.

entertainment.title: "Don't Want To Make A Big Deal Of It": Parvathy Thiruvothu, 38, Reveals She Has ADHD
entertainment.summary: Actor Parvathy Thiruvothu, 38, has disclosed her diagnosis of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). In a conversation with Ranjini Haridas on YouTube, she explained how ADHD influences her daily life and work. Parvathy emphasized her flexible approach to time, stating it is "elastic" and that she prioritizes her sleep, indicating a balanced perspective on managing her condition.
